2.  This first application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. has been filed for grant of bail.

Applicant has been arrested on 14.05.2024 in connection with Crime No.137 of 2024 registered at Police Station Jigna, District Datia (M.P.) for offence under Sections 376, 506 of IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act.
3. This application was filed on 29.05.2024 and approximately six months have expired and the case was adjourned thrice on earlier occasion.

It is submitted by counsel for the applicant that the family member of arguing counsel is not well and therefore, prays for time.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-GWL:19719 2 MCRC-23344-2024 4.
